title: TRICARE Reserve Select Early-Duty Month Credit - Premium Accounting Bulletin
content:
**Premium accounting bulletin - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Reserve Select.**

## The calculation

The early-duty month credit is figured as the days of the most recently paid month after the plan's termination date, multiplied by the amount billed for that month divided by the days its bill covers, with nothing taken off or added for coverage-type changes, rounded to the cent once at the end.

## Terms

- **Most recently paid month.** The coverage month of the bill that the latest posted premium payment on the plan settles; "its bill" is that bill, with the amount billed and the coverage days it shows.
- **When the credit arises.** It is figured on that month's bill once a later coverage month has already been billed on the plan; while the monthly bill with the latest due date is still the most recently paid month's own bill, the credit is 0.00.
- **Days after the termination date.** The days of the month that follow the plan's termination date, through the last day of the month; the termination date itself is not among them. A plan with no termination date recorded has no day after it in the month, and the credit is 0.00.
- **Result.** Rounded to the cent once, at the end, and never less than zero.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A TRICARE Reserve Select Member-Only plan; the latest payment settled the June bill of 61.17 covering all 30 days of June; the July bill has already been posted; the plan's termination date is 14 June.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Days after the termination date | 15 to 30 June, 16 days |
| Amount billed divided by days covered | 61.17 divided by 30 |
| Credit | 16 multiplied by 61.17, divided by 30, is 32.624, rounded once to 32.62 |

Had the July bill not yet been posted, the credit would be 0.00.
